effect_on_comparison: Adds procedure; the ex officio assessment duty already existed in 2019. Still in force (referenced by 1/2025).

relevant_content: Persistent aggressors: automated report regardless of level; tell the aggressor control may extend to other victims; device requests must cite other victims; special relevance alto/extremo → reassess other active victims and contact those inactive <90 days; "Caso Persistente" in the dossier.

relevant_content: Inactivation reform: no-apreciado/bajo inactivation needs no measures, an in-person interview at least once; medio+ only for death, prison, abroad; non-location 6 months; renunciation only no apreciado/bajo/medio; creates "inactivación supervisada" (6-month look-back, 6-month minimum, exit after two VPER-S at no apreciado, evaluator-discretion entry).
effect_on_comparison: Origin of supervised cases and of the narrowed renunciation rule; several 2024 parameters were shortened in 2025.
